name: Kosmos-1101
about: Kosmos-1101 (1979-042B), a crewed vehicle (TKS VA), launched 1979 May 22. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1979 May 22), held fixed
GCAT names the site (-) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in
